about_the_game:
Guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts.

They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together.

Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life.    

I don’t know their names. In general, I don’t know that much... But I’ll try to tell you something!

Girl. A little (or maybe a lot???) crazy, energetic, and bright personality. She stutters when embarrassed, loves to tease, provoke, or say something silly... just to let her emotions out! She has a complicated relationship with her parents, she’s an introvert... And sometimes she experiences panic attacks (don’t tell her I told you that)!

Guy. A calm, sometimes a bit slow... but very attentive and caring young man (not the tidiest one, I must say!). He is shorter than her, but that doesn’t bother them at all. He tends to be overprotective of the girl but tries to overcome it. He always wears long-sleeved clothes... I can’t say what happened to his parents. However, he is feeling much better now, really!

The queen, Miss Galaxy, the ruler of the world! Or just Tonya. A big Flemish Giant rabbit. She currently lives at the guy’s house, though she used to live on his parents’ farm. She loves to chew on clothes and zoom around at night (well, she is a nocturnal animal). Despite her size, she’s the girl’s favorite stress reliever.

Yes, our menu is an old-school CRT monitor with exhaust pipes! (don’t ask...)
And our textbox is a multimedia device! Inside, you’ll find everything you need—video settings, audio settings, and much more. The technology may be old, but it still works!

The girl loves to draw, and you will need to create a drawing for the guy, made by her hand! I hope you manage to make something at least a little better than mine...


We tried to add as many animations, camera work, and directing techniques as possible to make the visuals more dynamic and alive!

This is a deeply personal story filled with psychological depth, drama, love, and so much more—things that cannot be expressed in words but can only be felt through reading. And I really hope that everyone who reads it will understand what I mean ^^. Enjoy!
